user.title: Connect to your library
user.description: Enter the web address of your library's online catalog (the page where you search for books and sign in), plus your library card number and PIN. The library is detected automatically.

data_description.site_url: For example https://mylibrary.na2.iiivega.com. This must be the Vega catalog itself, not the library's main website.

reauth_confirm.title: Sign in again
reauth_confirm.description: The library rejected the saved PIN for card {username}. Enter the current PIN.

error.cannot_connect: Could not reach that address. Check it and try again.
error.invalid_auth: The card number or PIN was rejected.
error.unknown_library: That address does not look like a Vega Discover catalog. Use the address of the page where you search the catalog and sign in.

abort.already_configured: This library card is already configured.

data.max_covers: Most covers to show (extras become a +N tile)
data.deadline_days: Warn this many days before a pickup deadline (0 = never)
